rows.result: robots.txt present, valid Shopify config. Declares sitemap, does not block key templates (/collections/, /pages/, /products/), and disallows crawl traps (sort_by, multi-filter, +/%2B, preview params, cart/checkout/admin).

sitemap.xml index reachable (200), valid, referenced in robots.txt; children cover products (x2), pages, collections, blogs, plus sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml. No lastmod in the index (normal for Shopify).
rows.next_action: Confirm submission + coverage status in GSC (Sitemaps report) via Composio.

rows.result: URLs are clean, lowercase, hyphenated (/collections/<handle>, /products/<handle>). Exceptions: dated operational handles (creative-31-10-2023) and one malformed blog slug with an embedded URL ('https-inc5shop-com-blogs-blog-top-4-best-mens-formal-shoes').
rows.next_action: Fix/redirect the malformed blog slug; retire dated handles as part of index cleanup.

rows.result: Key categories reachable within 2-3 clicks via mega-nav (Women/Men/Handbags), and store pages are linked in the footer. Priority collections are shallow.
rows.next_action: Add contextual cross-links from high-impression blogs to matching category pages to pass authority (e.g. heel guides -> /collections/womens-heels).

rows.result: Examined pages resolve directly with 200 (no chains observed). Legacy domain inc5shoes.co.in is referenced in policy copy; its redirect relationship to inc5shop.com is unverified.
rows.next_action: Verify inc5shoes.co.in -> inc5shop.com is a single-hop 301; audit for broken internal links after collection cleanup.

rows.result: Single canonical host/protocol (https://inc5shop.com). Collection and PDP emit self-referencing canonicals; no conflicting host signals found.
rows.next_action: Spot-verify homepage canonical (not captured in extraction).

rows.result: Index bloat: 150+ collections discovered, including many dated/operational 'dark' collections (testnew, test, put-in-draft-22-11-2023, zero-stock-25-09, full-fresh-aug-2023, creative-*, inventory-active-from-draft, shoot selections). robots.txt allows /collections/, so these thin/duplicate collections are crawlable and likely indexable, diluting crawl budget and competing with canonical shoppable collections.
rows.next_action: Noindex or unpublish operational/seasonal-dead collections; keep the XML sitemap scoped to canonical shoppable collections; validate coverage in GSC Pages/Indexing report.
